content_boundaries: Threat remains suspenseful rather than sadistic
sensitivity_requirements: Fear responses should not be mocked

scene_state.purpose: Create a locked visual reference for Ren before panel production.

ren.wardrobe: dark long coat, visible white shirt collar, messenger bag strap

composition.sheet_layout: Orthographic turnaround across the top with expression studies and proportion guide below.
composition.proportion_guide: Keep height relative to Mira, coat length, glasses placement, and messenger-bag strap consistent.

manga_style.linework: clean ink linework with restrained screen tones
manga_style.line_weight_strategy: Strong outer silhouette, medium clothing folds, and fine glasses and facial details.
manga_style.solid_black_strategy: Use compact black hair and clothing accents without merging glasses into the face.
manga_style.screen_tones: Light neutral tones separate coat, shirt, trousers, and messenger bag.
manga_style.contrast_plan: Glasses, eyes, hands, and bag strap remain readable at reduced reference size.
manga_style.depth_plan: Flat reference presentation with limited form shading for construction clarity.
manga_style.motion_language: Static turnaround poses; expression studies use restrained head and shoulder changes.

required_elements: consistent face and hairstyle across all views
blocking_reasons: Image generation is disabled for the pilot fixture.
